name: OLYMPIA
recent: Olympia Industries 近期终止了与 DutaLand Berhad 的 Consortium Agreement 和 Development Agreement，该终止已于 2026 年 9 月 1 日生效。公司还面临 K Residence 买家上诉被上诉法院驳回的法律诉讼，并获得了 OSK 的 2000 万令吉融资。此外，公司发生了董事会及委员会成员变动。
notable: 终止与 DutaLand Berhad 的 Consortium Agreement 和 Development Agreement，已于 2026 年 9 月 1 日生效。
获得 OSK 的 2000 万令吉融资。
上诉法院驳回 K Residence 买家的上诉，并判给 6 万令吉诉讼费。
risks: 公司涉及重大诉讼，K Residence 买家上诉被驳回。
公司获得 2000 万令吉融资，负债率升至 53.7%。

news.title: Olympia Industries: Court of Appeal Dismisses K Residence Buyers’ Appeal, RM60,000 Costs Awarded
Court Dismisses K Residence Owners Appeal Against Olympia Industries Involving KL Landmark
Olympia takes RM20M ($4.91M) OSK facility, pushing gearing to 53.7%

recent_en: Olympia Industries recently terminated the Consortium Agreement and Development Agreement with DutaLand Berhad, effective 1 September 2026. The company also faced litigation where the Court of Appeal dismissed K Residence buyers' appeal, and obtained a RM20 million facility from OSK. Additionally, there were changes in board and committee members.
notable_en: Terminated the Consortium Agreement and Development Agreement with DutaLand Berhad, effective 1 September 2026.
Obtained a RM20 million facility from OSK.
Court of Appeal dismissed K Residence buyers' appeal and awarded RM60,000 costs.
risks_en: The company is involved in material litigation; K Residence buyers' appeal was dismissed.
The company obtained a RM20 million facility, raising gearing to 53.7%.
